ValidationRule.description: Method value is required when task type is Core sales task and Sub type is Discovery Call, WO Business Profile, WO Proposal or WX Proposal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(AND(ISBLANK(TEXT( NSP_Method__c )),ISPICKVAL(Type, "Core Sales Task"), OR(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Event_Subtype__c, "Discovery Call" ), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Event_Subtype__c, "WO Business Profile" ), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Event_Subtype__c, "WO Proposal" ), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Event_Subtype__c, "WX Proposal" ))),NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.EventValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please choose a value for method when the Event type is Core Sales Task and Sub type is Discovery Call, WO Business Profile, WO Proposal or WX Proposal
